description: Archives all cards in a Trello list; while cards can be restored via the Trello interface, this action does not provide an unarchive function.

idList.description: The unique identifier of the Trello list from which all cards will be archived.

ArchiveAllListCardsResponse.description:
Response schema for `ArchiveAllListCards`.

The Trello API endpoint POST /1/lists/{id}/archiveAllCards returns a 200 OK status code
upon success with an empty response body. The official Atlassian Trello API documentation
does not specify a response body schema for this endpoint.
